zh-CN.title: 加宽合并聊天预览
items: 合并聊天视窗加宽至普通文字消息的可见最大宽度，内部内容更易阅读
手机端内嵌预览会使用当前生效的聊天背景
完整预览及其内部嵌套记录保持一致的消息方向和背景

en.title: Wider merged chat previews
items: Merged chat viewports now match the visible maximum width of text messages for easier reading
Inline previews on mobile now use the active chat background
Full previews and their nested records keep message direction and backgrounds consistent
